## Foods & dishes
- [[WorldCuisines]]: 4 dishes, none Sierra Leone-only. No other food dataset.

## Ingredients & food composition
- No national FCT is in the vault. The [[FAO INFOODS global databases]] candidate (priority 2, directory of 308 tables) includes the FAO/INFOODS **West African Food Composition Table (WAFCT)**, a regional table for the ECOWAS countries including Sierra Leone; processing it is the most direct way to get local foods (fonio, cowpea, shea, baobab, leafy sauces). Until then, use [[USDA FoodData Central]] by name matching.
- [[CMAUP]]: 92 plants.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]]: 57 ethnobotany records (43 taxa), mostly Ayensu.
- [[KNApSAcK Family]] lists Sierra Leone on its World map, but African flag pages were not scraped (counts unknown).
- Compound → effect chains come from the global backbone via [[Global]] ([[FooDB]], [[CTD]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[SpiceRx]], [[DDID]] for food–drug interactions).

## Gaps
- No Sierra Leonean dishes (cassava-leaf, groundnut soups) in any food dataset.
